title: Hour Bands for No-Shows and Late Cancellations — Personal Services Plan Schedule
content:
Under the Personal Services Plan the band hours of a missed visit depend on how the order was missed and, for a cancellation, on the calendar day it was received.

## Schedule rule

The band hours of a missed visit are the package's no-show hours where the order was recorded as a no-show, the package's late-cancellation hours multiplied by 0.5 where the resident's cancellation was received on the calendar day before the visit, and the package's late-cancellation hours where it was received on the visit's own calendar day.

The kind of miss (resident cancellation or no-show) and the moment the cancellation was received are those recorded on the order's cancellation; the calendar day is the date part of that moment, compared with the visit date.

## Band hours by tier

| Tier | No-show | Cancellation received on the visit's own calendar day | Cancellation received on the calendar day before the visit |
|---|---|---|---|
| Personal Services Pay-As-You-Go Plan | 1.0 | 1.0 | 0.5 |
| Personal Services Essentials Package | 1.0 | 1.0 | 0.5 |
| Personal Services Companion Package | 1.0 | 1.0 | 0.5 |
| Personal Services Comfort Package | 1.0 | 1.0 | 0.5 |
| Personal Services Premier Package | 1.0 | 0.5 | 0.25 |
| Personal Services Concierge Package | 0.5 | 0.0 | 0.0 |

The day-before column is the same-day figure multiplied by 0.5.

## Hypothetical cases

- Premier Package, visit on 14 May, cancellation received at 21:00 on 13 May: the calendar day before, so 0.5 multiplied by 0.5, or 0.25 band hours.
- Premier Package, the same visit cancelled at 08:00 on 14 May: the visit's own calendar day, 0.5 band hours.
- Concierge Package, staff arrive on 14 May and the resident is absent: a no-show, 0.5 band hours.
